## Key fields to include: DNA Extension

:::: {.columns .fields .dense}

::: {.column width="34%"}
[Required]{.field-label}

- `occurrenceID` — <span class="small-note">links to the occurrence row</span>

[Strongly recommended]{.field-label}

- `DNA_sequence` — <span class="small-note">ASV/OTU sequence</span>
- `target_gene` — <span class="small-note">e.g. "COI", "18S rRNA"</span>
- `target_subfragment` — <span class="small-note">e.g. "V4"</span>
- `env_broad_scale` — <span class="small-note">biome</span>
- `env_medium` — <span class="small-note">what was sampled</span>
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
[Strongly recommended, cont.]{.field-label}

- `pcr_primer_name_forward` — <span class="small-note">and reverse</span>
- `pcr_primer_name_reverse`
- `pcr_primer_forward` — <span class="small-note">the sequence itself</span>
- `pcr_primer_reverse`
- `pcr_primer_reference` — <span class="small-note">where the primer pair is published</span>

[Recommended]{.field-label}

- `seq_meth` — <span class="small-note">e.g. "Illumina MiSeq"</span>
- `otu_class_appr` — <span class="small-note">e.g. "DADA2 v1.18"</span>
- `otu_db` — <span class="small-note">reference database</span>
- `sop` — <span class="small-note">link to your protocol</span>
- `samp_vol_we_dna_ext` — <span class="small-note">volume sampled</span>
:::

::: {.checklist-link}
These are the fields you will use most — the full OBIS list of required and recommended terms is at [manual.obis.org/checklist.html](https://manual.obis.org/checklist.html)
:::

::: {.notes}
WoRMS = World Register of Marine Species. Every marine occurrence should have a WoRMS AphiaID as the taxonID. For freshwater / terrestrial taxa use the appropriate backbone (CoL, etc.). Unidentified sequences should still be included — they can be assigned taxon later.

Everything OBIS marks required or strongly recommended for the DNA table is on this slide. env_broad_scale and env_medium are the two that tend to get missed; they are MIxS core and nothing elsewhere in the archive carries them.

The five primer terms are one idea in five fields: the names of each primer, the sequences of each, and the citation for the pair.

samp_vol_we_dna_ext is where the volume of water sampled goes, and sop is the laboratory protocol. Neither belongs in sampleSize or samplingProtocol on the occurrence side.
:::
